entries.text: An enemy must read at gameplay distance: light body silhouette against the arena palette, oversized emissive eyes, contrasting accent limbs - dark-on-dark palettes are invisible in play.

A legless Humanoid enemy needs a COLLIDABLE HumanoidRootPart (CanCollide=true) + HipHeight tuned to the body height - an all-non-collide assembly sinks through the floor leaving floating nametags and out-of-range attacks.

Enemies must ANIMATE per AI state or they read as sliding blobs: give custom models Motor6D joints (not WeldConstraints), author idle/chase/attack/death clips on the template with the animation tools, and have the server AI play them per state - the attack clip's HitFrame marker times the damage so the coil-back telegraph is real and dodgeable.

Enemy death needs a sequence, not removal: play a collapse clip, anchor the root, tween part transparency, THEN Destroy - and count the kill on Humanoid.Died BEFORE any of it so wave/score accounting never races the cleanup.
